items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: And I played with another band. I played a while with Benny Moten.

ctx.x: Was he from New Orleans? Yeah. Oh, yeah. He was born in New Orleans. Did you go to this trip to Yucatan, Mexico with Tolles or was this earlier?

I didn't go to Yucatan, Mexico with nobody. Oh, yeah. I went to China and I went to the Philippines Islands and I've been to Shanghai. And I've been all over Canada, you know, Mexico for them. Oh, you're traveling a lot. And I played with another band. I played a while with Benny Moten.
Oh, Benny Moten, out of Kansas City?
